sources.label: RA 7279: Urban Development and Housing Act (UDHA) of 1992 — Housing Classifications
sources.description: Defines housing classifications: socialized housing (for underprivileged), economic housing, and open market housing in the Philippines.

sources.label: DHSUD BP 220 Standards — Minimum Lot Sizes and Housing Categories
sources.description: BP 220 provides standards for socialized and economic housing including minimum lot sizes, floor areas, and community facility requirements.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule III — Residential Occupancy Classification
sources.description: Defines residential occupancy categories (Group A: single-family, Group B: multi-family) and their specific code requirements.
